_source: One entry per file in img/pd/. Source URL, title, author and licence as the source page gives them. An empty string means not stated at the source; never a guess. See README.md in this folder.

_example.file: the filename in this folder, exactly
_example.source: the page the file came from, not the direct image link
_example.title: the title on the source page
_example.author: the photographer or agency named on the source page
_example.place: only if the source states it
_example.date: only if the source states it, ISO where possible
_example.checked: the date someone opened the source page and read the licence
